plan.title: Scholarship Applications Summary
plan.subtitle: Overview of applicant demographics, status distribution, and scheme popularity

panels.title: Total Applicants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Category Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Category", COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC

panels.title: Status Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Status", COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC

panels.title: Top 5 Schemes by Applicants
panels.sql: SELECT "Name of scheme", COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

plan.narrative: The dashboard provides a concise overview of scholarship applications. {{p1}} applicants have been recorded in total, highlighting the scale of the program. The category distribution pie chart ({{p2}}) illustrates the proportion of applicants across various categories, aiding in resource allocation decisions. The status bar chart ({{p3}}) shows the current stage of processing for each application status, enabling the board to monitor workflow efficiency. Finally, the table ({{p4}}) lists the five most popular scholarship schemes, offering insight into which programs attract the most applicants and may require additional funding or outreach.
